craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta of release named; vyabhicāri peace at knowing-is-release. Sanskrit-first: parijñāna (KNOWING-THROUGH — kept ‘through and through’); jīvanmukti (LIVING-FREE — kept ‘while living, free’); smaryate (REMEMBERED — tradition kept). Rows: 1 (‘as is remembered’ closes — authority last: the verse ends where authority lives), 9 (release/fullness/free triple drum), 12 (śānta-settle: living-free-remembered). Close: ‘as is remembered’. Rupture: semicolon (release turns to fullness — knowing turns to living). Rejected: ‘while still alive’ — killed: technical kept; ‘it is said’ — killed: remembered kept; ‘salvation’ — killed: release (mokṣa kept release). Read aloud: TO-know the REAL through AND-through — re-LEASE, FROM the su-PREME-lord … THAT is the a-WAK-ened's FULL-ness: WHILE-liv-ing, FREE — AS is re-MEM-bered.

lines: To know the real through and through — release, from the supreme Lord;
that is the awakened's fullness: while living, free — as is remembered.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yat tattvasya parijñānaṃ sa mokṣaḥ parameśataḥ | tat pūrṇatvaṃ prabuddhānāṃ jīvanmuktiś ca sā smṛtā

reads_against.argmap: What is release? → Knowing is release, lived, remembered — no sequencing.
c1_essence: Knowing-through is release from the Lord: fullness, living freedom, remembered.
